rejectedCandidates.reason: Important flowers, foliage or cake details meet or cross the frame edge.
Cake scale or busy background is inconsistent with the selected collection.
Not selected: foliage-only design, tight framing, mixed dried material, or overlaps with a better selected design.
Original source resolution below 450px short edge / 800px long edge; not upscaled.
Visible source-business watermarks; excluded without removing watermarks.
